messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In the Mounjaro prescribing information, SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834) was a 40-week trial.
The trial was in adults with type 2 diabetes.
The adults had blood sugar that was not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone.
Patients received once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg, or placebo.
After 40 weeks, 78% to 85% of adults taking Mounjaro achieved an HbA1c below 7%.
This is compared with 23% of adults taking a placebo.
The average HbA1c change was -1.8% with Mounjaro 5 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -1.7% with Mounjaro 10 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -1.7% with Mounjaro 15 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -0.1% with placebo.
Triplet: ["placebo", "achieved hba1c below 7%", "23% of adults"]

The relation 'achieved hba1c below 7%' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject treatment or drug resulted in the specified percentage of participants achieving an HbA1c level below 7%.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has treatment for hypoglycemia': The subject drug is associated with the treatment or intervention specified by the object entity for managing hypoglycemia.
B. 'has reduced efficacy in': The subject drug may be less effective in patients with the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'has eradication rate': The subject therapy achieves the specified rate of eradication of the target condition.
D. 'has weight loss percentage': The subject drug or treatment is associated with the specific percentage of weight loss described by the object entity.
E. 'can cause complications in': The subject condition or substance may lead to adverse health effects in the specified group of individuals.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
